slot_scores.evidence_quote: What should the transportation plan primarily aim to achieve? Options: A. Minimize total pollution generated by all trips. B. Minimize the total number of trips made. C. Just find any plan that satisfies all the stated requirements.

slot_scores.name: demand_inequality
slot_scores.evidence_quote: How should the required produce volume of 1000 units be interpreted? Options: A. Exactly 1000 units must be transported. B. At least 1000 units must be transported; carrying more is acceptable. C. Up to 1000 units may be transported; carrying less is acceptable.
slot_scores.rationale: The agent directly clarified whether the produce requirement is an equality or inequality, covering the hidden slot.
